answer.text: Performance fee is charged on every gain
Performance fee is charged only for net positive returns above investor's previous highest portfolio value

explanation.text: The Logic: HWM caps performance-fee triggers to genuine new peaks, preventing double-charging. The Trap: Charging on every gain or reimbursing losses both misstate HWM. Cross-Exam Context: Same mechanism in XIX-A, XIX-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Keep per-client HWM ledger and reset only after peak is breached and fee paid.
